A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''security guard''' [[Death/Legends|perished]] around the time of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fall]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. While on the run from [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], [[Nom Anor]] pilfered the guard's corpse for a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] to use against his pursuer.
